summary: Implemented per-symbol RB Governor validation mode in run_pipeline.py. Added _merge_per_symbol_strategies() module-level function and _run_per_symbol_rb_governor() method on Pipeline_Orchestrator. The per-symbol mode loads individual per-symbol pools from pools/per_symbol/, filters train/val data per symbol, temporarily disables RB_REQUIRE_SYMBOL_FILTERS, runs RB Governor per symbol with exception isolation, and merges results with even capital distribution. Both the full pipeline (run()) and single-phase (run_phase()) paths support per-symbol mode. No changes to rb_governor.py.
notes_for_reviewer: The _run_per_symbol_rb_governor() method discovers symbols by globbing pools/per_symbol/phase2_*_pool.json rather than reading the merged pool, per the task spec
RB_REQUIRE_SYMBOL_FILTERS is temporarily set to False via try/finally to ensure restoration, since per-symbol rules already have 'symbol is S' conditions from Phase 2
Capital is distributed evenly: each rule gets min(RB_DEFAULT_CAPITAL_PCT, PHASE4_MAX_TOTAL_CAPITAL / n_rules)
Data filtering uses df[df['symbol'] == symbol].copy() to avoid SettingWithCopyWarning
Exception isolation: each symbol's run_rb_governor_pipeline() call is wrapped in try/except; failures log a warning and continue to the next symbol
Added RB Governor support to run_phase() for phases 3 and 4 (single-phase mode) — this was missing in the original code for RB-enabled runs
Also updated handoffs for tasks 1 and 2 that were stale (unrelated diff noise) — only run_pipeline.py was intentionally modified

test_results.merge function verification: Capital distribution correct (35.0 total cap, evenly split across merged rules)
